name: literals_full
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,re,subprocess,sys
r=json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text());pro=json.loads(Path('original-provenance.json').read_text())
for x in pro:
 raw=Path(f"originals/{x['id']}.jsonl").read_bytes();o=json.loads(raw); token=re.search(rb'"statement"\s*:\s*("(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*")',raw).group(1)
 x.update(statement_token=token.decode(),statement_token_sha256=hashlib.sha256(token).hexdigest(),statement_utf8_sha256=hashlib.sha256(o['statement'].encode()).hexdigest())
 print(x['id'],o['statement'],'\nSOURCE',o['source_url'])
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py'),'original-provenance-full.json'],input=json.dumps(pro,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
